about.compute: NumPy on the CPU (Apple Accelerate BLAS); no GPU
about.conventions: see the docstring of diffusion_reference.py; DDPM t = 0..1000 (linear β unless 'cosine'); flow t ∈ [0, 1] with t = 1 noise; σ = √((1 − ᾱ)/ᾱ)

metrics.dist: mean distance to the swirl's centre line (data: 0.024; lower than that = too tidy)
metrics.off: fraction of samples > 0.1 from the curve (data: 0.001)
metrics.coverage: fraction of the 40 curve pieces with ≥ ¼ of their fair share (data: 1.0)
metrics.fd: Fréchet distance of raw 2D coordinates vs 20,000 data points (FID's formula)
metrics.ode_error: mean distance to the exact ODE solution from the same noise (Heun, 1,000 Karras steps)

forward.snapshot_recipe: x0 = dr.swirl(1000, seed=0); eps = dr.gaussian_noise(1000, seed=1); x_t = dr.q_sample(x0, t, eps, alpha_bar)  (alpha_bar = dr.ALPHA_BAR or dr.ALPHA_BAR_COSINE)

grid.note: points = all (x, y) pairs, x fastest; scores (not ε)

training_paths.recipe: x0 = dr.swirl(5000, seed=3); eps = dr.gaussian_noise(5000, seed=4); DDPM: dr.q_sample(x0, t, eps) for t = 1000 … 0; flow: dr.flow_interpolant(x0, t, eps)

guidance.convention: ε̃ = ε_u + w·(ε_c − ε_u) (guidance scale; w = 0 unconditional, 1 conditional). Ho & Salimans' w′ = w − 1.
guidance.sampler: DDIM, 100 steps, η = 0, same noise z for every w

blobs.setup: dr.blobs_mixture(): 3 round blobs, std 0.15, centres at radius 0.6 (90°, 210°, 330°); class 0 = top

langevin.start: uniform noise in the square [−1.5, 1.5]², 2,000 particles, seed 11

settings.annealed: 10 noise levels σ = 1 → 0.01 (geometric), 100 steps each, ε = 2e-5 (α = ε·σ²/σ_L²)
